reason: RLRC reports pruning/quantization, up to 8x memory reduction and 2.3x inference speedup, but its evaluated system is a vision-language-action robot policy whose objective and action-generation stack are VLA-specific. title: RLRC: Reinforcement Learning-Based Recovery for Compressed Vision-Language-Action Models
